attchmntText: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of Q2 & H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call
voiceSummary: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on 13th November 2026. For Q2 FY27, standalone income was INR833 crores, up from INR642 crores in the corresponding quarter last year. H1 FY27 total income stood at INR1,537 crores. Q2 FY27 EBITDA was INR53.4 crores with a margin of 6.4%, compared to INR17 crores in Q2 FY26. H1 FY27 EBITDA was INR101 crores with a margin of 6.5%. Profit after tax for Q2 was INR6.7 crores against a loss of INR18 crores in Q2 FY26. H1 FY27 profit was INR9.5 crores against a loss of INR44.1 crores. The debt-equity ratio is approximately 1.1x. Management highlighted improvements in yarn, home textiles, and technical textiles, with technical textiles expected to contribute from FY28.

attchmntText: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited published a notice regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. B & A Packaging India Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the same period. Net profit for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was Rs. 79.24 lacs, compared to Rs. 317.54 lacs in the previous year. Earnings per share for the quarter were Rs. 1.59. RPG Life Sciences Limited announced a reduction in the maximum retail price of Oxaliplatin Injection 5 mg/mL in 10 mL vial. The revised maximum retail price is Rs. 2,400.00, inclusive of goods and services tax, effective immediately in November 2026. This change complies with an order from the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority dated 2nd November 2026.

attchmntText: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited has released the audio recording of its Earnings Conference Call held on 13th November, 2026. The call discussed Q2 and H1 FY27 Results. The meeting took place at 4.30 p.m. IST. The company previously informed investors of the call date in a letter dated 05th November, 2026. The audio file is available for access via the provided link on the company website. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations, 2015. The announcement was issued by Manoj Contractor, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited filed an investor presentation regarding un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Total income for H1FY27 was Rs 1,537 Cr, up 23.4% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs 101 Cr, with a margin of 6.5%. Profit after tax was Rs 9 Cr, compared to a loss of Rs 44 Cr in H1FY26. For Q2FY27, total income was Rs 833 Cr, up 29.7% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs 53 Cr, and profit after tax was Rs 7 Cr. Total borrowings were Rs 968 Cr in H1FY27. The company reported improved profitability driven by a richer product mix and cost discipline.

attchmntText: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Q2H1FY27 Press Release".
voiceSummary: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited filed un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. H1 FY27 total income was Rs. 1,537 Cr, up 23.4% year-on-year. H1 FY27 EBITDA was Rs. 101 Cr, up 346.6% year-on-year, with a margin of 6.5%. H1 FY27 profit after tax was Rs. 9 Cr, compared to a loss of Rs. 44 Cr in H1 FY26. Q2 FY27 total income was Rs. 833 Cr, up 29.8% year-on-year. Q2 FY27 EBITDA was Rs. 53 Cr, up 205.6% year-on-year. Q2 FY27 profit after tax was Rs. 7 Cr, compared to a loss of Rs. 18 Cr in Q2 FY26. The announcement includes a press release detailing these financial highlights and operational commentary.

attchmntText: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sutlej Textiles and Industries Limited announced the approval of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 13th November, 2026. For the half year ended 30th September, 2026, revenue from operations was 1,520.09 crores. Profit before tax stood at 14.50 crores. Profit for the period was 9.39 crores. Earnings per share were 0.57 rupees. Total assets as at 30th September, 2026, were 2,251.56 crores. Equity was 832.60 crores. Borrowings totaled 1,019.12 crores. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and statutory auditors.
